term: symbiont-mediated suppression of host CRISPR-cas system
basis: Core function. Independent of the redox question: AcrIIC1Vei inhibits type II-C Cas9 with zero cysteines (PDB 9J2G).
No signal peptide, lipobox or Tat motif; full chain ordered in six structures; target Cas9 HNH is cytoplasmic. Inference from sequence and target, not from a localisation experiment.

term: cell redox homeostasis / response to oxidative stress
basis: No evidence AcrIIC1 participates in redox homeostasis. The disulphide is a property observed under 1 mM DTT or 5-fold H2O2 in vitro, not a demonstrated physiological regulatory event.
AcrIIC1 is a substrate of thiol chemistry in vitro, not a catalyst of it.
The BP term above is more informative. If an MF is wanted, a Cas9/HNH-directed inhibitor term would be the lead, not generic protein binding.

term: redox-dependent homodimerisation as a regulatory mechanism
recommended_action_LEAD: DO NOT PROPAGATE to a GO term
basis: The switch point has never been measured; the only measured comparable cytoplasmic potential (-314.4 mV) lies outside the range the authors assumed; the cysteines are absent from most of the family.
